create_video_transform: create a VideoTransform instance to preprocess video tensors for encoding with frame sampling and normalization
run_video_transform_call: run the VideoTransform call method on a batch of video tensors with shape batch time height width channel
sample_frames_method: sample frames from a video tensor using F.interpolate to match the desired time samples count
resize_hw_method: resize the height and width of each video frame to the specified resize shape using torchvision resize
normalize_video_method: normalize video tensor values to mean 0 and std 1 using configurable mean and std parameters
